rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who behaves without politeness or manners.

example.english: They never greet people; they’re really rude.
example.traditional: 佢見到人都唔打招呼，真係冇禮貌。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin3 dou2 jan4 dou1 m4 daa2 ziu1 fu1 zan1 hai6 mou5 lai5 maau6

rows.note: Use this when the person’s manner is especially rough, coarse, or uncouth rather than merely impolite.

example.english: They shout at people in the street all the time; they’re really rude.
example.traditional: 佢成日喺街度大聲鬧人，真係粗魯。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 hai2 gaai1 dou6 daai6 seng1 naau6 jan4 zan1 hai6 cou1 lou5

rows.note: Use this stronger, often disparaging expression when calling someone rude by blaming their upbringing or lack of discipline.

example.english: You insulted your mother in front of everyone; you’re really rude.
example.traditional: 你當住咁多人面前鬧阿媽，真係冇家教。
example.jyutping: nei5 dong1 zyu6 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 naau6 aa3 maa1 zan1 hai6 mou5 gaa1 gaau3
